reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: AIWG is an orchestration CLI whose documented workflows intentionally invoke local tools after user approval.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Shell execution boundaries, approval gates, or command dispatch code changes.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: AIWG installs and manages project-owned workflow, agent, skill, and context files.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Install roots, path validation, or write authorization behavior changes.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: AIWG retrieves explicitly selected public resources and serves opt-in local integrations.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Remote origins, transport policy, or network-facing commands change.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: The CLI reads documented environment configuration while secret values remain excluded from reports and logs.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Environment-variable handling or redaction policy changes.

reviewedCapabilityAlerts.rationale: Public, versioned web resources are a supported AIWG distribution channel.
reviewedCapabilityAlerts.revalidateWhen: Resource URL allowlisting or release distribution changes.
